title: Import/Link Framework & Initial Provider Adapters
objective: Implement and prove a bounded provider-safe import/link framework and initial adapters over completed AAI rights, capability, playback and semantic foundations without widening rights or gameplay authority.

import_link.local_import_rule: User-owned local import requires explicit reference and ingest rights, provenance/license evidence and a supported runtime media probe; possession never expands rights.
import_link.provider_link_rule: Provider link uses existing AAI-02 provider/source/reference identity or a caller-supplied identifier explicitly classified non-secret; linking never implies entitlement, ownership or operation rights.

credentials.rule: Credential material is runtime-only and excluded from source, persistence, fixtures and deterministic evidence.

transport.rule: Validation uses injected fake transports and performs no live provider calls.

semantic.rule: AAI-05 provider-neutral semantic selection is consumed without provider substitution or ranking mutation.

terms.rule: Rights, capability, current terms/entitlement, semantics and runtime evidence remain independent fail-closed gates.

persistence.result: No durable AAI-06 canonical persistence required.

nonauthorization: provider audio acquisition/copy/cache absent independent authority

repair_history: Integrated AAI-06 into the canonical workflow namespace and repaired the initial documentation marker mismatch.
Closed operation-right, capability and provider-reference bypasses and added focused regressions.
Completed caller-supplied non-secret provider identifier support across contract, scenarios, tests, verifier and documentation.
Aligned the final entitlement invariant marker found by exact-head validation.
preserved_boundaries: AAI-01..06 are completed_verified with no further implementation authority
rights/provenance, capability, provider terms/entitlement, semantic compatibility and runtime availability remain independent and fail closed
no provider/catalog is canonical and provider references or caller identifiers never imply entitlement
unsupported operations cannot be emulated by scraping, reverse engineering or prohibited copying
next_action: Closed. AAI-06 is completed_verified with no further implementation authority. AAI-07 is selected_not_started only; a future owner Continue must freshly verify canonical heads and resolve its bounded event/scene/automation binding contract before implementation begins.
